title: a signed-out visitor sees that something is happening, and is asked in to read it

criteria.text: An anonymous caller cannot retrieve an announcement body from the database, by any route
criteria.note: `page_posts` has no anonymous read (`to authenticated`); `announcements_withheld` has no body in its return type (#914, #969) [V migrations 20261018170000, 20261019143000]. Checked: `tests/announcements-signed-out-rest.test.ts` `[guards F093.1]` asks PostgREST with the publishable key; #218 records it failing on the pre-migration database, and `tests/f093-red-runs.json` now names that PR (#1047) [V]. Nothing merged for it since 2026-10-23 [V git log]. Reviewed no: #218 and #230 carry no `Reviewed by:` [V]. Shipped: Deploy health green on 75c682a8, 1fc06c8b, bfbbd619 [V]. Smoked unknown: the smoke does not call PostgREST.

criteria.text: The same is true of the start time and the place, and of any later column that carries them
criteria.note: Same policy; the return type has no `starts_at` or `location_id`; `kind` (#969) is the Page's kind [V]. `[guards F093.2]` selects `starts_at, location_id` as anon and expects no rows; #906 ran it against a mutant anon policy (red-runs ledger: #906); the exact-column allow-list under F093.3 covers later columns [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes (75c682a8, 1fc06c8b, bfbbd619). Smoked unknown (PostgREST).

criteria.text: Withholding is enforced in SQL: a projection that never selects the body, not a filter
criteria.note: `announcements_withheld` returns ten named columns since #969 [V migration 20261019143000]. `[guards F093.3]` asserts that exact key set with a reason per column, watched failing in #230 (ledger) and red on any further column [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes (75c682a8, 19109a1e, b7766901, 1fc06c8b, bfbbd619). Smoked unknown (PostgREST).

criteria.text: The signed-out card carries exactly five things; a Page with no or a hidden photo shows its kind's default image
criteria.note: Photo, name, count with its period, the details line and the sign-in call, no body, time, place or Page location; a no-photo or hidden-photo card draws the kind's art (#969) [V `WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx`, withheld-announcements.ts]. `[guards F093.4]` in `tests/f093-withheld-card-criteria.test.tsx` asserts the five things against real rows and the art's `data-kind`; red before the migration (#969, ledger); mutants in #769 [V]. Reviewed no: #218, #230 no line; #969 `Reviewed by: Claude (Explore lane)`. Shipped: 75c682a8, 19109a1e, bfbbd619 green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live green daily 10-24 to 10-30, run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) opening root and explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator; it loads the route, it does not tap [V].

criteria.text: One card per Page, with the count and its period in words; a Page with none this period keeps its card without a nought
criteria.note: One row per Page (#230); label 'N posts this week', zero reads 'A new post'; the period follows `post_current_until` (#914) [V withheld-copy.ts]. `[guards F093.5]` checks both against real rows, seen failing against mutants (#769, ledger) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes (75c682a8, 19109a1e, 1fc06c8b). Smoked yes (run 41093000135, explore signed out, 2026-10-30) [V].

criteria.text: A signed-in member sees no change whatsoever
criteria.note: `[guards F093.6]` in `tests/f093-front-door-guards.test.tsx` reads bodies, times, places, tags and order as a signed-in member through the real Page and Explore loaders and expects no withheld card; seen failing against 8 mutants (#770, ledger) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #255); shipped yes (75c682a8, a7814ce9). Smoked yes (run 41093000135 opens explore as member, owner and operator) [V]. Caveat: Explore for members keeps changing on purpose (#932, #1086); this scenario's claim is about its own change only.

criteria.text: Signed-out Explore still contains post-kind rows, in withheld form
criteria.note: `loadBrowse` merges `getWithheldAnnouncements` into the signed-out mix, one card per Page in reach (#932); the signed-out posts-only view lists the same cards (#906) [V load.ts]. `[guards F093.7]` in `tests/f093-signed-out-explore.test.tsx` and `load-withheld.test.ts` (two whole markers) load Explore through the real `loadBrowse` as anonymous; failed on main before the fix and against two mutants (#906, ledger) [V]. Reviewed no (#218 no line; #906 review-skipped). Shipped: 75c682a8, 7286b487, f8578fbb green [V]. Smoked yes (run 41093000135, explore signed out) [V].

criteria.text: Signed-out front door: name, photo, description and the withheld card; no location, tags or founder; no map pins; indexable
criteria.note: `anon` loses `locations`, `anchor_location_id`, `page_tags`, `tags`; `browse_feed` returns null location, empty tags and no geography signed out (#932); no quick links signed out (#931); `?view=map&focus=` only signed in (#944); `robots.ts` admits search crawlers [V]. #1074 (2026-10-26, bug #978, review-skipped) made the Page's place one query and asserts it is never read signed out; the signed-out Page is unchanged [V PR body, resolve-shop.test.ts]. `[guards F093.8]` in `tests/f093-front-door-guards.test.tsx`, `member-reads-audit-db.test.ts`, `item-url.test.ts` (mutants #770, ledger) [V]. Button reads 'Sign in to see what's happening' (2026-10-04 ruling, placeholder copy). Reviewed no (#255, #259 no `Reviewed by:`). Shipped unknown: no Deploy health run for 73625848 (#259); 4d71a8c8 green [V]. Smoked yes: run 41093000135 opens explore signed out; page rides only when its route is in the day's list [V].

criteria.text: An #announcement-<id> link, to any of the Page's announcements, lands on a page that resolves with the one card marked
criteria.note: `WithheldPagePosts` carries an anchor per announcement id; the database returns all ids for a Page (#230) [V]. `[guards F093.9]` renders the Page for the latest and an older id, expects one marked card with the sign-in call, no 404; mutants #769 (ledger) [V]. Reviewed no (#230); shipped yes (19109a1e); smoked yes (run 39977671049 on 2026-10-23 opened page signed out after the last merge here; it does not follow an anchor) [V].

criteria.text: Nothing on the signed-out surface is a link to a body; the ask comes first
criteria.note: The sign-in call links to `/auth/login?next=<Page>`; the card link goes only to the Page; no quick links signed out (#931) [V `WithheldAnnouncementCard.tsx`]. `[guards F093.10]` collects every link on the signed-out Explore card and Page card and matches them against Page or sign-in only; mutants #769 (ledger) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes; smoked yes (as 9).

criteria.text: The card is the same for every anonymous reader
criteria.note: Nothing on the withheld path reads a cookie, header, storage, clock or place; signed out the reach starts from the market's principal city (#932) [V]. `[guards F093.11]` renders for two readers with different headers, timezones and cookies and expects identical output, and scans the path files for per-reader reads; mutants #770 (ledger) [V]. Reviewed no (#218, #230); shipped yes; smoked yes (run 41093000135, explore signed out).
